98.text: Click the positive sign to fly up or the negative sign, to fly down. Then click the box, type the number of places the coupe will fly, and click the Go button. Click the New Game button to start a new game.

scope: Introduction prose, stationary emphasis overlays, sign and distance symbols only. Not the complete introduction scene.
